bio: Research Background Education Contact Us Jessica Liu is a biostatistician in the Biostatistics and Research Design (BARD) Center . She collaborates with clinicians and scientists across many disease areas, providing statistical support for the design and analysis of observational and clinical studies. Jessica joined Boston Children’s Hospital in 2022 as a biostatistician in the Biostatistics and Research Design Center. She earned a master's of public health degree in biostatistics from University of Cincinnati in 2019 and a master's of busines administration degree in business intelligence from Xavier University in 2018.
